page.title: February Boat Rentals in Marbella 2027: What to Expect from the Weather

data.meta_description: Plan your Marbella boat rental weather February 2027: expect 16°C highs, 11°C lows, 6h sun, 50mm rain. Book your charter now.
data.summary: February 2027 in Marbella brings mild 16°C highs and 11°C lows with about 6 hours of daily sunshine and 50mm of rain. Learn what to expect from the weather for your boat rental.
key_facts: Average low temperature: 11°C (52°F) – bring a light jacket.
Sea temperature: around 15°C – suitable for a quick dip, not long swims.
Rainfall: ~50mm over 7-8 rainy days in the month.
Sunshine: 6 hours of sun per day – mostly clear mornings.
Wind: light breezes from the west, 10–20 km/h typical.
Water conditions: calm in Puerto Banús, slight chop offshore.

faq.q: Is February a good time for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, February offers mild weather and fewer crowds. With average highs of 16°C and 6 hours of sun, it's perfect for a scenic cruise along the coast. Just pack a jacket and enjoy the calm seas.

faq.q: What is the sea temperature in Marbella in February?
faq.a: The Mediterranean sea temperature in February 2027 is around 15°C. While not warm for long swims, a quick dip is possible if you're brave. Most guests prefer enjoying the views from the deck.

faq.q: How much rain does Marbella get in February?
faq.a: February sees about 50mm of rainfall spread over 7-8 days. Showers are usually short and pass quickly, so you can still enjoy clear skies between them. Check the forecast before booking.

faq.q: What should I wear for a February boat trip in Marbella?
faq.a: Dress in layers: a t-shirt, a sweater, and a windproof jacket. Bring a hat and sunglasses for the sun, and non-slip shoes. The breeze on the water can feel cooler than on land.

faq.q: Are boat rentals available in February in Marbella?
faq.a: Absolutely. Our fleet operates year-round from Puerto Banús. Boats like the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are available for 2-hour to full-day charters. Book in advance for best availability.

faq.q: What routes are best for a February boat charter?
faq.a: Popular February routes include cruising along the Golden Mile to Cabopino or heading west to Estepona. The coast is quieter, and you can enjoy the views of La Concha mountain from the sea.

faq.q: Will the weather cancel my boat rental in February?
faq.a: Rarely. February storms are infrequent. If strong winds or heavy rain are forecast, we'll contact you to reschedule or offer a full refund. Most days are perfectly fine for sailing.

faq.q: What is the sunset time in Marbella in February?
faq.a: Sunset in February 2027 occurs around 18:30 to 19:00. A late afternoon charter from 16:00 to 18:00 lets you watch the sun dip over the Mediterranean – a magical experience.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental weather February 2027 guide is essential if you're considering a winter getaway. February in Marbella offers mild Mediterranean conditions with average highs of 16°C, lows of 11°C, and around 6 hours of daily sunshine. While it's not peak summer, the weather is stable enough for comfortable cruising, especially in the sheltered waters of Puerto Banús. With fewer tourists and lower prices, February is an excellent month to explore the Costa del Sol from the sea.

Average Temperatures in February 2027

Daytime temperatures in Marbella during February 2027 typically reach 16°C (61°F), dropping to 11°C (52°F) at night. The sea temperature sits around 15°C, so while swimming is possible, most guests prefer staying on deck. The air feels cooler on the water due to the breeze, so bring a light jacket or fleece. Compared to northern Europe, these are positively spring-like conditions.

Sunshine and Daylight Hours

February offers about 6 hours of direct sunshine per day, with sunrise around 08:15 and sunset between 18:30 and 19:00. Mornings are often clear, with clouds building in the afternoon. This makes late-morning to early-afternoon charters ideal for maximum sun. The low angle of the winter sun creates beautiful golden light for photos along the coast.

Rainfall and Wind Patterns

February sees about 50mm of rain over 7-8 days, but showers are usually brief and scattered. Wind speeds average 10–20 km/h from the west, keeping the sea relatively calm in Puerto Banús. Offshore, you might encounter a slight chop, but our experienced skippers adjust routes for comfort. The Sierra Blanca mountains shield Marbella from the worst weather.

Best Boats for February Charters

For a February outing, we recommend enclosed or semi-enclosed boats for comfort. The Marbella boat rental fleet includes the Azimut 39 (11 pax, €749/2h) and Astondoa 40 (9 pax, €749/2h) with saloon areas to escape the breeze. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax, €4,719 minimum 4h) offers a spacious interior. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

Popular February Routes

February's mild weather suits coastal cruising. A popular route heads east from Puerto Banús past the Golden Mile to Cabopino, where you can see the sand dunes. Another option is west towards Estepona, passing the exclusive Sotogrande marina. The calm waters near Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are perfect for a quiet anchorage. Views of La Concha mountain are stunning in the winter light.

What to Pack for a February Boat Trip

Pack layers: a t-shirt, a fleece or sweater, and a windproof jacket. Non-slip shoes are essential. Bring sunglasses and sunscreen – the UV index can still be moderate. A hat helps against the breeze. If you plan to swim, a wetsuit is advisable. Our charters provide water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks, but you can bring your own food.

Book Your February Charter Now

February is a quiet month for charters, meaning more availability and personalised service. Prices start from €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with all taxes included. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on other boats. Don't wait – secure your Marbella boat rental weather February 2027 trip today.
